name: Architecture: Distributed Redlock Split-Brain & Clock Drift Race Condition
description: Diagnose an intermittent split-brain condition in a multi-region Redis Redlock implementation where process pauses and NTP clock drift allow two workers to acquire lock leases simultaneously during failover.

claude_code.notes: Repeated hallucinated lock renewal loops before reaching correct fencing token solution.

kobayashi_full.notes: Turn 1-2 run on Luna. After 2 consecutive test failures, Circuit Breaker automatically triggered stateless call_advisor (Claude Sonnet 5.5). Sonnet provided monotonic fencing tokens in a 520-token distilled response. Cost: $0.038 vs $0.315 (87.9% savings).
